$comment: Engine tests that exist on one side only, with the reason. check-parity.mjs --strict fails on any unlisted difference AND on any entry here that is no longer needed. 'DISAGREES' marks a real behavioural difference between the engines that is reported, not fixed.

dart.hashes a real file through a RandomAcces: Dart-only rafReader adapter over dart:io; the web reads Blob slices.

dart.parses every OpenSubtitles search fixtur: Dart maps API rows in SubtitleCandidate.fromOpenSubtitles; the TS mapping is tested in api.test.ts.

dart.says so when the count is unknown: DISAGREES: Dart prints 'SIGNED IN · TICKETS UNKNOWN' (and quotaAfterLogin fills remaining); TS prints '20 TICKETS A DAY'.
dart.carries the pending tear flag for the de: DISAGREES: Dart only flags the tear and the widget holds the old count; TS ticketStrip adds the torn ticket back itself.

ts.reads no tickets left on an HTTP 406 wha: TS-only status406 option; Dart zeroes the quota in threading.dart on a 406 (threading test 'inserts sign-in first when the quota is exhausted').
ts.shows the count before the tear while th: DISAGREES: see the Dart entry 'carries the pending tear flag…'.
ts.refills the strip once the reset time ha: TS-only injected clock; the Dart strip has no reset refill.
ts.reads unknown when signed in before any: DISAGREES: see the Dart entry 'says so when the count is unknown'.
ts.keeps the known count when signing in ag: TS quotaFromLogin takes the previous quota; Dart quotaAfterLogin has no previous-quota input.
ts.derives the total from requests plus rem: TS-only fallback in quotaFromDownload; Dart quotaAfterDownload never derives a total.
ts.refreshes the quota from the user info w: TS-only quotaFromUserInfo (/infos/user); the Dart engine has no equivalent.

dart.formats the mpv sub-delay value: Native-only: mpv's sub-delay property; the web shifts VTT cues instead.

ts.remembers the offset for the same movieh: TS OffsetBook lives in the engine; Dart persists offsets in the drift data layer, outside lib/engine.

dart.emits renumbered SRT: Native-only: toSrt writes a sidecar beside the file; the web never writes SRT.

dart.sends the raw filename when the name is: Dart builds the search query inside the machine; TS builds it in api.ts (api.test.ts covers it).
dart.skips to a name search when the file van: Dart distinguishes HashUnavailable in the machine; the TS reducer receives hashed:null for both cases and is tested once.
dart.lists name results but never spends a ti: Dart-only immediate free name search on a hash miss.
dart.runs a manual search from the stall and: DISAGREES: Dart retry() after a failed manual search re-runs the hash/name rung, not the typed query; TS repeats the manual query.
dart.stalls instead of hanging when a port th: Dart ports can throw; the TS reducer has no ports (its caller maps errors to a 'failed' event before reduce).
dart.lists a subtitle once when the hash and: Dart-only merge of the immediate name search on a hash miss (STATUS D3).

ts.stalls with the sign-in sentence instead: Web-only: the Worker refuses anonymous downloads; native builds may spend the anonymous pool.
ts.announces each phase once: TS emits announce effects from the reducer; Dart announces from the widget layer.
ts.runs a manual search with the typed quer: DISAGREES: see the Dart entry 'runs a manual search from the stall…'.
ts.ignores fallback choices and results tha: TS reducer event guards; Dart drops stale results with a generation counter (covered by the tap-override test).
ts.lists other prints for a pick instead of: TS-only 'research' event: the booth lists the results (attached file excluded) instead of spending a ticket.
ts.downloads a print picked from the booth: TS-only: the web booth's pick in phase done; the native booth downloads outside the threading machine.
